subject: general
question: Which of the following has NO pair of parallel sides?
solution:
Concept:

**Rectangle**: A quadrilateral its opposite sides are equal and parallel and each angle measures 90°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/595f7d66bf36affbb2ca94c7235fab3635fabd3c1769c71c3e59b30fdb9397e0.png] 

 
• Rhombus -

 
 
• It has opposite sides parallel and opposite angles are equal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c9778250351afcb3063023c25afdc0a5f028ad32da5c7e7d6672245093e33f2.png] 

Trapezium - has only one pair of parallel sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8be7fa790026712e051b01071bee123312785123a3557389eb68adeee786a5d6.png] 

**Kite:**

A kite is a unique quadrilateral figure that has two pairs of equal adjacent sides. It's only symmetrical along one diagonal, and its diagonals are perpendicular to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0e479e2223264d8537bf5595244394a6751d7bdf8a6f2bc40b832d8737f56f2.png] 

Parallel lines: Parallel lines can be defined as two lines in the same plane that are at equal distances from each other and never meet.

**The answer is kite. **
